stem: What is the author’s main claim in the selection “Say Yes to Exploring Mars”?
instruction: Use “Say Yes to Exploring Mars” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: Sending astronauts to visit Mars would be worth the effort.

options.label: B
options.text: Astronauts have all of the qualifications that are needed to travel to Mars.

options.label: C
options.text: Going to Mars is the only way for humans to know if life exists on the planet.

options.label: D
options.text: A mission to Mars will never happen if it does not take place soon.
